source_summary: Tall Chinese landscape with monumental blue-green cliffs at left, pavilion architecture in the lower foreground, pine and bamboo clusters, a distant river with misty sandbars and boats, and small travelers on a riverside path. Calligraphy, seal marks, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_layered_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the large upper-left mountain mass with rounded peaks, arching cliff faces, dark blue-green washes, stippled rock edges, and the leafy overhanging brush canopy crossing the top ridge.
must_preserve: rounded ochre peak silhouettes
blue-green mineral wash on shaded cliff faces
black ink contour lines along rock edges
dense stippled texture at cliff seams
fine twig-and-leaf linework across the upper ridge
horizontal ledge lines and pale mist openings within the rock

motifs.name: central_needle_peak_pine_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow central rock pinnacle and adjoining sloped hill with a compact stand of vertical pines, including the pale cliff face and dark dotted texture along the ravine edge.
must_preserve: tall pale needle-like rock silhouette
dark ink outlines on both cliff edges
green-blue shaded ravine washes
small vertical pine trunks and needle clusters
stippled moss dots along the rock margins
soft transition into the lower slope

motifs.name: hidden_ravine_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion cluster tucked in the central ravine, with layered roofs, tiny railings, surrounding dark trees, and the enclosing cliff walls immediately around it.
must_preserve: miniature tiled roof geometry
stacked roof eaves and ridge lines
tiny wall and railing details
dark tree mass below the buildings
surrounding vertical cliff washes
fine ink outlines that separate architecture from rock

motifs.name: distant_river_sandbars_boats
motifs.description: Isolate the broad right-side river distance with pale horizontal sandbars, mist-like banks, long low shoreline contours, and the small sailing boats near the middle-right water.
must_preserve: thin horizontal ink lines marking sandbars
soft pale ochre riverbank shapes
misty negative-space water gaps
small boat hulls and triangular sails
delicate distant shoreline contours
subtle layered washes suggesting atmospheric depth

motifs.name: riverside_travelers_path
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right rocky riverside path with small traveler figures, a mounted rider or pack animal, attendants, low cliff edge, and surrounding water gaps.
must_preserve: tiny human figure linework
animal legs, head, and saddle/load details
thin path outline along the river edge
dark stippling on the low bank
small rocks and water cutouts around the path
scale contrast between figures and landscape

motifs.name: foreground_pavilion_complex
motifs.description: Isolate the large lower-left multi-story pavilion compound built into the rocks, including curved tiled roofs, railings, columns, windows, decorative ridge ornaments, and the seated scholar visible inside the upper room.
must_preserve: layered sweeping roof geometry
rows of individual roof tiles
decorative roof-end ornaments
straight column and railing linework
window lattice patterns
interior seated scholar figure
warm red-brown architectural color accents
rock base and stair-like foundation immediately supporting the pavilion

motifs.name: left_foreground_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense foreground pines rising beside and behind the pavilion on the left, with tall trunks, exposed roots, rounded needle clusters, and dark mossy bases.
must_preserve: long vertical pine trunks
gnarled branching structure
rounded radiating pine needle clusters
exposed root and bark linework
dark ink moss dots near bases
blue-green wash shadows on adjacent rocks
overlap of trees in front of cliff without pavilion architecture

motifs.name: foreground_twisted_tree_bamboo_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-center gnarled tree and bamboo thicket over layered rocks, including twisting trunks, fine branch sprays, bamboo leaves, low shrubs, and shaded boulders.
must_preserve: large twisting trunk contours
fine angular branch linework
clusters of narrow bamboo leaves
dense low shrub texture
rounded boulders with blue-green shadows
stippled rock edges and moss dots
interlaced roots crossing the foreground rock

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
